description: Rank every served area (or one region's, region='North West') by one metric for one month and return the top N with rank, value, unit and quality. Tied values share a rank (competition ranking); each row carries tiedCount, the number of areas sharing its value. Use it to answer 'which areas have the lowest crime / highest GBP/m2' or 'the least deprived' (deprivation is the official IMD decile, 10 = least deprived: order desc), 'the highest household income' (income, GBP a year) or 'the most social renting' (social-renting, % of households; neutral, never call it better or worse). Areas with suppressed values are excluded. Census layers (census-*, student-share) describe residents and are refused: never rank areas by who lives there. The find_areas factors disorder, epc-share, leasehold-share and schools rank too (latest value, period ignored). One metric only: to weigh several criteria, budget or commute for a household use find_areas.

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: The callId of the answer you are rating.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

period.description: Month, YYYY-MM: defaultPeriod or one of periods in list_metrics detail=[metric_id].
period.title: Period

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried. Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.

region.description: Only areas of one English region: its code (E12000001-E12000009) or name, e.g. 'North West', 'London'. Omitted: every area Close Knit covers.
region.title: Region
